who.value: TCG buyer, often new to Carousell auctions

job.value: Check the card and current bid, then place a bid

arrivedFrom.value: a timed-auction card on Explore, SERP or the Event page

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The card photo, 'S$620 (2 bids)', countdown '2d 5h 48m' and 'Place bid' make it a listing up for auction.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The full-width red 'Place bid' button in the bottom bar is the most prominent element.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Place bid', '(2 bids)' and the info icon next to the reserve line predict what they do.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Reserve price not met' has an info icon, but 'PSA 10' and 'Special Illustration Rare' rely on TCG knowledge (fine for this audience).

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Deciding whether to bid uses price, time left and the card photo they can see.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Details like 'Condition' and 'Set' sit below the fold and reserve explanation is behind the info icon.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything serves evaluating and bidding on this card.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: The price row is short, but 'Reserve price not met' plus 'Reserve price applies to this listing' says the reserve twice, adding reading before the action.
